recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source change is needed for FHIR-17709; if an implementation still rejects multiple source statements, track it in the implementation repository named in the Jira comment.
issue_request: FHIR-17709 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core FHIR-I change request asking to allow multiple source elements in a FHIR Mapping Language rule. The Jira description said the spec already indicated one or more source elements could be taken from the source but the FHIR Transformation engine did not support that feature.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-17709. Commit 1982a32c0578897ed621e9ee8a7e1bf74198c295 reworked source/mapping-language.html in December 2018 to define source content as one or more comma-separated source statements and to describe multiple-source permutation behavior.
additional_context: mapping-language.html is active build content via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini, and StructureMap.group.rule.source has cardinality 1..*. FHIR-25376 later clarified all/AND matching for multiple source statements, was applied by commit 0646c3096026cde98eca996d111806e36ed14572, and already has combined-branch audit commit 357ed7dc2b4b9c4938d532584ddad2fa3d5af693.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already says source content specifies one or more source elements, uses one or more comma-separated source statements, executes permutations, and requires all multiple source statements to match.
